access_token.name: access_token
access_token.comment: The short-lived token sent with every request.

account.name: account

email.name: email
email.comment: Sign-in address. Unique whatever its case.

language.name: language
language.comment: Language of the emails sent to the person.

health_consent_at.name: health_consent_at
health_consent_at.comment: When the person agreed to their health data being stored.

confirmed_at.name: confirmed_at
confirmed_at.comment: When the email was confirmed. Null until then.

change_count.name: change_count
change_count.comment: The last change number given to a row of this account. Sync takes the next one, under a lock on this row.

disabled_at.name: disabled_at
disabled_at.comment: When an admin disabled the account, which then cannot sign in or refresh. Null while in use.

account.comment: A person's account. It exists from sign-up; until confirmed_at is set, its phone stays a guest and uploads nothing.

admin_audit.name: admin_audit

actor_id.name: actor_id
actor_id.comment: The admin who did it. Null once that account is deleted.

action.name: action
action.comment: What was done, such as admin.promote.

target.name: target
target.comment: What changed, such as an account id or an exercise slug.

admin_audit.comment: What an admin did: one row per admin write, kept after the admin's own account is deleted.

body_measurement.name: body_measurement

value.name: value
value.comment: The measurement. Null once the entry is deleted.

changed_at.name: changed_at
changed_at.comment: The time the phone gave to the latest write; the later one wins.

change_number.name: change_number
change_number.comment: Position of this row in the account's stream of changes.

body_measurement.comment: One entry per metric and day, in kg or cm. Latest write wins.

catalog_exercise_revision.name: catalog_exercise_revision

slug.name: slug
slug.comment: The exercise's stable key. Never changes; a retired exercise stays.

revision.name: revision
revision.comment: Revision number of this slug, from 1.

content.name: content
content.comment: JSONB: the shared Exercise (names, muscles, equipment, instructions, and so on).

variation_group.name: variation_group
variation_group.comment: Number of the variation group the exercise is in, if any.

variation_rank.name: variation_rank
variation_rank.comment: Place in its variation group, easiest first.

published_in.name: published_in
published_in.comment: The catalog version that published it. Unused; see catalog_version.

seq.name: seq
seq.comment: Place in the stream of published revisions, taken from catalog_publication. Null for the draft.

catalog_exercise_revision.comment: One revision of one exercise. A slug has at most one draft (no seq) and any number of published revisions, which are never changed. The current catalog is each slug's revision with the highest seq.

catalog_publication.name: catalog_publication
catalog_publication.comment: The publication cursor. One row; publishing reserves numbers under its lock, so seq follows commit order.

catalog_version.name: catalog_version
catalog_version.comment: To be dropped: a numbered published version of the catalog. Nothing reads it now that publications are numbered by seq; a later migration drops it (ADR 0030).

confirmation_token.name: confirmation_token

token_hash.name: token_hash
token_hash.comment: SHA-256 of the token; the token itself is never kept.

confirmation_token.comment: The links sent to confirm an email. A token is deleted once used.

confirmation_watch.name: confirmation_watch

token_hash.name: token_hash
token_hash.comment: SHA-256 of the mailed link's token; only opening that link marks the watch confirmed.

key_hash.name: key_hash
key_hash.comment: SHA-256 of the random key the phone sent at sign-up and asks with.

confirmed.name: confirmed
confirmed.comment: True once the link was opened.

confirmation_watch.comment: Lets a phone on "Check your email" ask whether its link was opened. A key is tied to the one link mailed in that sign-up.

password_reset_token.name: password_reset_token

account_id.name: account_id
account_id.comment: The account whose password the link resets.

created_at.name: created_at
created_at.comment: When the link was sent; used to limit how many are sent.

password_reset_token.comment: A mailed link that sets a new password once, within an hour. Sent only to a confirmed address.

planned_workout.name: planned_workout

day.name: day
day.comment: The day it is planned on.

changed_at.name: changed_at
changed_at.comment: The time the phone gave to the latest write; the later one wins.

deleted.name: deleted
deleted.comment: True once taken off its day.

change_number.name: change_number
change_number.comment: Position of this row in the account's stream of changes.

planned_workout.comment: A workout planned on a day. Latest write wins; a deletion is a write, kept as a row.

refresh_token.name: refresh_token

used_at.name: used_at
used_at.comment: When it was used. Null while unused.

refresh_token.comment: Trades for a new pair of tokens, once. It is kept after use, so a second use is noticed and the whole sign-in revoked.

schema_version.name: schema_version

version.name: version
version.comment: The number of the next migration file to apply.

schema_version.comment: The version of this schema in the database, kept by Database.migrate. One row.

session.name: session

source.name: source
source.comment: How it was done: GUIDED (a workout followed in the player), FREE, or another source.

ended_at.name: ended_at
ended_at.comment: When it ended. Null while unfinished.

workout_id.name: workout_id
workout_id.comment: The workout followed, if any. Not a foreign key: a workout is its versions.

workout_version.name: workout_version
workout_version.comment: The exact version of the workout followed.

format.name: format
format.comment: The workout's format when the session started: CIRCUIT or SETS.

totals.name: totals
totals.comment: JSONB: the phone's saved SessionTotals (active time, sets done, skipped and planned, distance, heart rate, and so on).

deleted_at.name: deleted_at
deleted_at.comment: When the session was deleted from History. Null otherwise.

change_number.name: change_number
change_number.comment: Position of the last change to this row in the account's stream of changes.

session.comment: A workout session's header. A deleted session keeps its row, with deleted_at set and no events, so the deletion reaches every phone.

session_event.name: session_event

session_id.name: session_id
session_id.comment: The session this event belongs to.

seq.name: seq
seq.comment: Place of the event in the session's log.

at.name: at
at.comment: When it happened, by the phone's clock.

payload.name: payload
payload.comment: JSONB: the event itself, such as started, phaseCompleted, paused, finished or a device sample.

change_number.name: change_number
change_number.comment: Position of this row in the account's stream of changes.

session_event.comment: One event of a session, never changed once stored. The session's state is the fold of its events.

setting.name: setting

key.name: key
key.comment: The phone's key, such as profile.name or settings.units.

changed_at.name: changed_at
changed_at.comment: The time the phone gave to the latest write; the later one wins.

change_number.name: change_number
change_number.comment: Position of this row in the account's stream of changes.

setting.comment: A person's synced profile field, unit or language, by the phone's key. Not the server settings (see settings).

settings.name: settings

updated_at.name: updated_at
updated_at.comment: When an admin last changed it.

settings.comment: Server settings an admin changes without a deploy, one row per setting. Only non-secret values; a setting with no row keeps its default from the environment. Not the person's synced setting.

sign_in.name: sign_in

device_name.name: device_name
device_name.comment: Name of the phone or browser, as shown in the account's list of sign-ins.

client.name: client
client.comment: What holds the credential, such as app or website.

last_refreshed_at.name: last_refreshed_at
last_refreshed_at.comment: When its tokens were last refreshed.

revoked_at.name: revoked_at
revoked_at.comment: When it was signed out or revoked. Null while valid.

sign_in.comment: One phone or browser signed in to an account. Its tokens live and die together.

sign_in_failure.name: sign_in_failure
sign_in_failure.comment: Failed sign-ins per address, to slow down password guessing. Not tied to an account.

workout_deletion.name: workout_deletion

change_number.name: change_number
change_number.comment: Position of this row in the account's stream of changes.

workout_deletion.comment: A workout deleted at a version. A newer version pushed later removes this row: the edit wins.

workout_version.name: workout_version

workout_id.name: workout_id
workout_id.comment: UUID of the workout, made on the phone.

name.name: name
name.comment: The workout's name in this version.

content.name: content
content.comment: JSONB: the whole workout (parts, steps, prescriptions), read with the shared Kotlin types.

change_number.name: change_number
change_number.comment: Position of this row in the account's stream of changes.

workout_version.comment: One version of a workout. A version never changes once stored; a push may only add the version that follows the latest.
